_comment: DEMO content for the live campus, written by scripts/seed-demo-content.mjs. Every document id starts with 'demo-' so it can be removed again with --remove. Rooms, clubs, events, notices, posts and reports are invented for the demo. Locations point at the real buildings (by id) and at their entrance node on the campus map. Event dates are offsets in days from the moment the script runs.

building-mvscxjhb.description: The new Engineering Block: computer science, AI/ML and electronics labs, the seminar hall and department offices.

building-mvscx4yb.description: School of Architecture: design studios, the model-making workshop and the architecture library.

building-mvsd4mun.description: The original engineering building: the Central Library, mechanical and civil workshops, physics and chemistry labs, and the examination section.

building-mvsd25ah.description: Two-wheeler and car parking beside the Main Gate, and the college bus bay.

building-mvsd7uu9.description: Main canteen with South and North Indian meals, snacks, juice and a stationery counter.

building-mvsd8jko.description: Girls Hostel and staff quarters. Visitors sign in at the warden's office at the entrance.

building-mvsdazrl.description: Boys Hostel with the hostel mess and a common room. Reached by the path from the Back Gate.

events.title: Line-follower robot workshop
events.description: Build and tune a line-following robot. Kits provided; bring a laptop.

events.title: ML sprint: predict the canteen rush
events.description: Teams of three model canteen footfall from sample data. Prizes for the top two teams.

events.title: Golden-hour campus photo walk
events.description: Meet at the Main Gate kiosk. Phones welcome.

events.title: Open mic night

events.title: Blood donation camp

announcements.title: Library open till 8 PM during internals
announcements.body: The Central Library reading hall stays open until 8 PM on all working days during internal assessments. Carry your ID card.

announcements.title: New: ask the Main Gate kiosk for directions
announcements.body: Press the button on the Campus Mithra kiosk at the Main Gate, ask for any building, and scan the QR code to get live walking directions on your phone.

announcements.title: College bus timings changed
announcements.body: From Monday, buses leave the bus bay at 16:45 and 17:30. The 18:15 bus runs only on Saturdays.

announcements.title: Placement drive registrations open
announcements.body: Final-year students can register at the placement cell (OB-110) until Friday. Bring two copies of your resume.

announcements.title: Water supply maintenance on Sunday
announcements.body: Water supply to the Old Engineering Building will be off on Sunday from 9 AM to 1 PM for tank cleaning.

knowledge.title: Library rules
knowledge.body: Students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days. Late returns cost Rs 2 per book per day. Bags stay at the counter. Silence in the reading hall.

knowledge.title: Connecting to campus Wi-Fi
knowledge.body: Join 'Campus-Student' and sign in with your college username and password. For problems, report an IT / Wi-Fi issue in the app with the building and room.

knowledge.title: College bus service
knowledge.body: Buses leave the bus bay next to the parking at 16:45 and 17:30 on weekdays and 18:15 on Saturdays. Bus passes are issued at the admission office.

knowledge.title: Applying for revaluation
knowledge.body: Apply at the examination section (Old Engineering Building, OB-G04) within 7 days of results, with the fee receipt and a copy of the hall ticket.

knowledge.title: Lost and found
knowledge.body: Items found on campus are kept at the security office at the Main Gate for 30 days. Bring ID to collect them.

knowledge.title: Anti-ragging and student help
knowledge.body: Ragging is banned. Contact the anti-ragging committee through the warden or the security office at any time. Complaints are confidential.

quiz.prompt: Which building is the Central Library in?
quiz.explanation: The Central Library is on the first floor of the Old Engineering Building.
The seminar hall is EB-G01 on the ground floor of the Engineering Block.

quiz.prompt: When does the last weekday college bus leave?
How many library books can a student borrow at once?
Where do you collect something you lost on campus?
options: Security office at the Main Gate
quiz.explanation: Found items are kept at the security office at the Main Gate for 30 days.

quiz.prompt: On which day are the Robotics Club build nights?
quiz.explanation: Build nights are every Wednesday in EB-005.

quiz.prompt: Within how many days of results must you apply for revaluation?
quiz.explanation: Apply at the examination section within 7 days.

quiz.prompt: Which gate is closest to the Boys Hostel?
quiz.explanation: The Boys Hostel path starts at the Back Gate.

posts.title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping in EB-101
posts.body: Anyone else losing Wi-Fi in Computer Science Lab 1 since the morning? It reconnects every few minutes.

posts.title: Canteen dosa is back on the menu
posts.body: Counter 1 has masala dosa again from 8 AM. Get there before the 10:30 break rush.

posts.title: Quiet spot to study during internals?
posts.body: The library reading hall fills up by 10. Any other quiet places on campus with plug points?

posts.title: 17:30 bus left early today
posts.body: The 17:30 bus left at 17:20. Please wait for the scheduled time.

reports.title: Ceiling fan not working
reports.description: The second ceiling fan from the door in Design Studio 1 does not turn on.

reports.title: Leaking tap near the canteen
reports.description: The hand-wash tap next to Counter 2 leaks continuously and the floor is wet.
reports.update: Plumber informed, will visit tomorrow morning.

reports.title: Seminar hall projector flickers
reports.description: The projector in the Engineering Block seminar hall flickers with HDMI laptops.

reports.title: Path light off near the Back Gate
reports.description: The street light on the path from the Back Gate to the Boys Hostel is off, the path is dark after 7 PM.

Shoots street photos and edits video. Happy to help with demo videos.
Plays bass, looking for a drummer for the open mic.
ML and Kaggle. Wants to build something useful for the campus.

kioskConfig.welcomeText: Namaste! Ask me the way to any building, or about events and notices. Scan my QR code to get live directions on your phone.
